summary: A woman who goes to the bathroom and finds a sign of blood: is she tamei? Rabbi Meir says it depends how she was sitting; Rabbi Yossi says she is tahor either way.

chunks.he: הָאִשָּׁה שֶׁהִיא עוֹשָׂה צְרָכֶיהָ וְרָאֲתָה דָם,

summary: A woman who has a regular sign before she becomes tamei counts her time only from when she finds it. The mishnah lists such signs and how a regular sign is set.

chunks.st: For any woman who has a fixed menstrual cycle that is not time dependent, but is dependent on a physical sensation, her time is sufficient,

chunks.en: her time is enough.
chunks.st: i.e., she does not transmit ritual impurity retroactively, for twenty-four hours or until the last time she examined herself (see 2a).
